question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus these SDK token-budget helpers as the stable public context-engine contract now, or fold the token-count signal into the broader assemble-metadata RFC at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82137?
rationale: The change is a public plugin API and SDK export surface, and a related maintainer-review RFC is open for the same `ContextEngine.assemble` contract area.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
options.body: Approve `currentTokenCount` now, but require generated baseline/doc-map updates and redacted live context-engine proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into RFC
options.body: Pause or close this branch and handle token counts together with the broader provenance/internal-event assemble metadata design.

options.title: Keep Runtime-Private
options.body: Avoid adding SDK exports until maintainers choose a longer-term plugin API and compatibility plan.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve `currentTokenCount` now, but require generated baseline/doc-map updates and redacted live context-engine proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most recent merged work on this exact assemble-budget path and are the current live assignee.
